description: Header file defining classes and structures for inspecting dynamically loaded Mach-O images on macOS, including DynamicImage and DynamicImages classes, with support for 32-bit and 64-bit architectures, used for debugging and introspection within the Google Breakpad project.

classes.name: DynamicImage
classes.description: Represents a single dynamically loaded Mach-O image, providing access to its properties such as load address, file path, size, and architecture details.

classes.name: DynamicImageRef
classes.description: A wrapper for a pointer to DynamicImage, enabling sorting and comparison of images.

classes.name: DynamicImages
classes.description: Manages a collection of dynamically loaded Mach-O images within a target task, allowing enumeration and inspection.

methods.name: GetHeaderSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the Mach-O header including load commands.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Returns the full file path of the Mach-O image.

methods.name: GetModDate
methods.description: Returns the modification date of the image file.

methods.name: GetLoadAddress
methods.description: Returns the actual load address of the image in memory.

methods.name: GetVMAddr
methods.description: Returns the preferred VM address for the image.

methods.name: GetVMAddrSlide
methods.description: Returns the slide (difference) between load address and VM address.

methods.name: GetVMSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the VM region occupied by the image.

methods.name: GetTask
methods.description: Returns the task port owning this image.

methods.name: GetCPUType
methods.description: Returns the CPU type of the task.

methods.name: GetFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type from the Mach-O header.

methods.name: Is64Bit
methods.description: Checks if the image is for a 64-bit architecture.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the image.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the image is valid based on its size.

methods.name: GetImage
methods.description: Returns a specific image from the collection by index.

methods.name: GetExecutableImageIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the main executable image.

methods.name: DetermineTaskCPUType
methods.description: Determines the CPU type of a given task.

methods.name: GetNativeCPUType
methods.description: Returns the native CPU type for the current architecture.
